description: Full prediction records: the crowd’s home/draw/away shares, the top 3 exact scores and most likely score (National), the Top 20% / Top 25% / All players groups (bands) and the expert cohort. Pass an id for one match, or mode/status filters for a list. outcome is null while fewer than 20 players have predicted.

mode.description: national (exact scores, 15 countries) or classic (home/draw/away, 25 matches a week); omit for both.

status.description: open, locked (final predictions, not played yet), played or cancelled; omit for all.
